thread:
jenna_csm: heads up — AtlasCorp jumped 3x on token throughput overnight. monitoring flagged they'll breach their soft throughput threshold tomorrow afternoon. thinking we should send a short notice + temporary bump. need alignment on timing and wording. :eyes:

ops-bot: [alert] Customer AtlasCorp (acct-AC-422) throughput spike detected: 3.1x baseline. projected soft-threshold breach in ~22 hours.

devon_se: we can apply a soft bump for 48h from the control plane, low risk. volunteer to make the change after we send notice. can someone confirm the exact new limits?

liam_support: +1 on the bump. will add a support note in case they see transient 429s. can we include the fallback advice in the comms? simple steps: (1) reduce burst by 20% (2) switch to shorter window retry with jitter.

jenna_csm: proposed bump: from 300 req/min -> 900 req/min for 48h. keeps per-token spend predictable. devon, can you confirm that's feasible?

devon_se: feasible. config path: `orgs/AC-422/limits/throughput` — will set `soft_limit: 900` and `soft_expiry: 48h`. pushing change after confirmation.

paul_account_mgr: FYI this account is in renewal evaluation in 6 weeks. we should flag the spike in the health summary and offer a short-term discounted Dedicated trial if they want sustained capacity. don't offer until we see post-bump usage.

maya_cs: drafted a short customer note — please review.

maya_cs: ```Subject: Temporary throughput increase for AtlasCorp (48h)
Hi Alex —

We noticed a large increase in your API traffic and expect you'll hit your current throughput threshold tomorrow. To avoid any disruption we've temporarily increased your throughput to 900 req/min for the next 48 hours. No action is required on your side.

If you expect this higher traffic to continue, we can discuss options like reserved capacity or tuning to reduce unit costs. If you notice any errors (429s) or latency, reply here and we'll jump on it.

Thanks — Jenna from Redwood CS
```

devon_se: wording looks good. suggest adding one sentence with immediate mitigation steps (see liam's bullets) and a link to docs.

maya_cs: updated draft: ```Subject: Temporary throughput increase for AtlasCorp (48h)
Hi Alex —

We noticed a large increase in your API traffic and expect you'll hit your current throughput threshold tomorrow. To avoid any disruption we've temporarily increased your throughput to 900 req/min for the next 48 hours. No action is required on your side.

If you experience any `429` responses or higher latency, try reducing burst rate by ~20% and using exponential backoff with jitter. Our support team is monitoring this thread: https://redwood.support/AC-422.

If you expect this higher traffic to continue, we can discuss reserved/dedicated capacity options and a short trial to keep unit costs predictable.

Thanks — Jenna from Redwood CS
```

liam_support: looks clear. I'll add the runbook link in the support doc: https://redwood.ops/runbooks/throughput-spike. Also recommend we include a one-time credit if they hit extra spend caused by the spike — aligns with renewal gesture.

paul_account_mgr: agree on a one-time credit offer; keep it modest and conditional on them continuing to evaluate dedicated options. I'll draft the contract language if they ask.

jenna_csm: plan: (1) send the note at 09:30 PT tomorrow to the AtlasCorp primary. (2) devon applies soft bump after send. (3) support adds runbook + watch dashboard for 48h. (4) paul prepares optional credit/offer. everyone OK? :white_check_mark:

devon_se: OK from infra side.

liam_support: OK, will be on watch.

paul_account_mgr: OK.

maya_cs: OK — scheduling email. will paste the final sent copy here after deploy. :email:
